violated_contract: A writer that joins a buffered Firestore transaction must not write before that transaction's reads are done. The batch admission view buffers its writes until flush, and flush reads privacy state; the provider-STT outbox row joined admission by setting its document on the raw transaction mid-body, so the next transactional read was a read after a write. Real Firestore refuses that, so every unsupported-language upload routed to the provider stage answered 503 at intake (staging 11-01, 20 of 20), while unit tests on in-memory stores passed.
canonical_prevention: Give the transaction view the only write path: a joining writer reads through the transaction and hands its write to the view (FirestoreTransaction.defer_set), which sets it at flush after every read. Run any admission hook that touches a second collection through the real view on the strict transaction fixture, which enforces read-before-write.
